messages.content: 我想在聖荷西附近的Walmart買蘋果、米飯和12罐瓶裝水。請顯示產品資訊和庫存情況。

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

message.reasoning: The user wants to buy apples, rice, and 12 cans of bottled water near San Jose Walmart. We need to retrieve product info and stock availability. We have a function walmart_purchase that can retrieve info. The function signature: walmart_purchase({loc: string, product_list: string[], pack_size?: number[]}). We need to call this function with location "San Jose" or "San Jose, CA" maybe. Provide product_list: ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"]. For bottled water, pack_size: [12] maybe? The function expects pack_size array same length as product_list. So we need pack_size: [undefined, undefined, 12] or maybe [null, null, 12]. But default is not use if not specified. So we can pass pack_size: [12] but that would mismatch length. The spec says "Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list." So we need array of same length. So we can pass [null, null, 12] or [0,0,12] or [undefined, undefined, 12]. Let's pass [null, null, 12]. The function will return product info and stock availability. Then we need to display product info and stock status. We'll call the function.
